device_entry.description: 用于 ACQ400/ACQ2106 数据采集系统的非物理主机端网络客户端，通过设备服务端口读取原始二进制数据，可用于实验中的通道数据拉取、分块传输和采集后数据处理。
device_entry.description_en: A non-physical host-side network client for ACQ400/ACQ2106 data acquisition systems. It reads raw binary data from device service ports and is used for channel data retrieval, block transfer, and post-acquisition data handling in experiments.

schema.description: 从服务端口读取指定数量的原始数据元素。
schema.description_en: Read a specified number of raw data elements from a service port.

schema.description: 以分块方式获取原始数据，便于连续传输或后处理。
schema.description_en: Retrieve raw data in blocks for continuous transfer or post-processing.

existing_tags.rationale: 通过设备服务端口在线读取原始通道数据，符合仪器数据采集场景。
